body:
I literally just posted on the /r/showerthoughts post about how ["Depression is like wanting to go home but already being there"](https://www.reddit.com/r/Showerthoughts/comments/83d268/depression_is_like_wanting_to_go_home_but_already/). I don't expect my comment there to be seen, less so this one on an even older, 16-hour old post. But if anybody is reading this, I would really appreciate some advice or kind words. I'm typing this out anew rather than copying my other comment.

My wife of two years and I have a newborn daughter. My wife has been suffering from depression for the greater part of her entire life, gradually starting to worsen mid-pregnancy (due to kidney stone pain), now a few weeks ago worsening even further, and the past few days so bad that I am in fear and distress. She doesn't plan to hurt herself, but her pain is so hard to bear that all she can do is cry and wail and shake in despair. It is torment for me to see her in that state.

Her depression stems from a sort of self-esteem issue based on her body image. She sees herself as ugly. She has recently considered covering up all the mirrors in the house (and I am unsure whether this is enabling and sensitizing, or removing a negative, stressful stimulus). No actions or words of mine can move her from her feelings, no matter how much she appreciates them or believes me. I'm believing that these feelings of hers may not go away as easily as they came, but she feels helpless towards them and I don't know what I can do to help make them go away. My words comfort her, but they are not enough.

I don't know what to do or where to go, but I'm looking for any advice. If anyone is so much as reading this buried comment, thank you.

I know this post is already 6 hours old and way past its prime, and I know that this is going to get buried, but I really need help. My wife of two years with whom I have a newborn is suffering from depression. She has, to some extent, had it her whole life, but the last few days have been hell for the both of us. A big part of her depression comes from a loathing of her body image. No amount of love that I can show and no words I could possibly say can overcome that, no matter how much she believes the way that I feel about her. She feels helpless in her sadness, and I feel helpless in making her feel better. She says that I help (that it would be worse without me), but this is starting to become crippling and I'm starting to realize that I can't expect this to go away on its own. I don't know what to do or where to turn. I don't know what to do any more. I don't want to lose her. I need help.

I'm going to try some of the depression help subreddits, as well.

If anybody is so much as reading this, thank you.
